answer: We formulate a dynamic security primitive where validating nodes deposit staking collateral to harbor block-production rights, while deviation triggers a subgame-perfect slashing penalty. In this decentralized system, honest validators remain in a non-cooperative meadow where expected rewards dominate, preventing any incentive to wander into identity multiplication. By forcing adversarial utility to be strictly negative through zero-knowledge verifiable delays, we guarantee a robust Nash equilibrium where Sybil strategies fail.
